cards.name: Solemn Judgment
cards.officialEffect: When a monster(s) would be Summoned, OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Pay half your LP; negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card.
adapterBehavior: Responds to the current Pending Normal/Flip/Special Summon attempt or to a Spell/Trap activation in Pending/Chain; ignores monster-effect activations and face-down Normal Sets.
Pays half the shared team LP at activation, rounding upward, and refuses a payment that would reduce the team to zero.
Negates the exact activation or summon object; it never chooses a replacement target at resolution.
Sends destroyed physical cards to the Graveyard of the seat encoded by their UID, including stolen cards and cards owned by inactive partners.
A negated Counter Trap still consumes its LP cost and goes to its physical owner's Graveyard.
Removes a negated Token Summon through the token ledger without adding a token to any Graveyard.
Uses card-lifetime epochs, top-of-Chain checks, bounded replay receipts, and physical inventory conservation.

implementation.integrationBoundary: Pure isolated adapter over the existing typed Pending/Chain state. Central resolver/Discord hook integration remains blocked on explicit M61 handoff.

catalogAtStart.source: coordination/state.json at the shared HEAD before M629 reservation

limitations: Solemn Judgment permanece fora de cardMetadata, cardCertifications, releasedCardIds e allowlist; a fixture usa uma Trap habilitada como fonte substituta.
O adapter não está ligado ao resolver v9 nem aos comandos Discord; a integração central aguarda handoff explícito M61.
A suíte é offline e não valida gateway, permissões, interações ou persistência real do Discord.
Nenhuma certificação, concessão de inventário, alteração de dados persistentes, merge ou deploy.
